cards.title: filter() keeps some items
cards.body: `nums.filter(x => x > 10)` makes a new array with only the items where the test is true.

cards.title: Arrow functions
cards.body: `x => x > 10` is a short function: it takes `x` and gives back `x > 10`.
cards.code:
const isBig = x => x > 10;
console.log(isBig(15), isBig(3));

cards.title: join() makes text
cards.body: `join(" ")` glues an array's items into one string, with the separator between them.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: `x % 2 === 1` is true for odd numbers, so only 1 and 3 are kept.

exercise.prompt: Read whole numbers on one line and print only the even ones, in the same order, separated by spaces. If there are none, print an empty line.

const nums = prompt().split(" ").map(Number);
